primary_diagnosis: The scene reads as a prompt-satisfaction set rather than a camera-observed real workshop.
visible_failure_hypotheses: Checklist staging: soybeans/tofu, cloth, molds, troughs, old wood, steam and wet surfaces are all conspicuously presented, making the scene feel assembled to prove the prompt.
Uniform photogenic patina: wood, cloth, stone and walls are all aged in similarly attractive ways instead of showing heterogeneous functional wear.
Cinematic atmosphere is over-coherent: steam, window light, glossy wet floor and warm-cool material contrast look art-directed rather than incidental.

Operational causality is weak: objects are semantically correct but there is little irregular evidence of one specific interrupted production moment, such as partial occlusion, incomplete work, asymmetric residue, awkward tool placement or mundane clutter.
Repeated generative motifs: draped cloths, perfect tofu blocks, rounded wet trough edges and polished old-wood highlights recur with suspicious consistency.

Framing is too solved: the 9:16 near/mid/far structure is cleanly designed and visually legible, but lacks the accidental obstruction, imperfect crop, exposure variation and focal ambiguity typical of documentary workshop photography.

causal_read.reason: Both A and B fail in the same realism direction, while B only wins relatively on composition/depth. Therefore the strongest current hypothesis is a shared base-prompt/scene-construction problem, not evidence that the six compact controls themselves create the AI look.

repair_principle.objective: Reduce staged prompt-checklist behavior and force a credible single in-process documentary moment while preserving the already-supported composition controls.

proposed_bounded_test.evaluation: human absolute AI-feel gate first; only if both are not immediate FAIL does relative blind comparison matter

shared_base_repair_spec: Anchor the frame to one specific active production moment, not a catalogue of all requested objects.
Allow required evidence to be secondary, partially occluded or awkwardly placed rather than hero-presented.
Prefer mundane functional wear, residue and asymmetry over uniformly beautiful heritage patina.
Avoid theatrical steam, glossy-wet-everywhere surfaces and deliberately picturesque window-light treatment.
Use imperfect documentary framing: partial crops, obstruction, uneven spacing, non-central subject balance and realistic exposure/focus falloff.
Keep surfaces food-safe and believable, but avoid showroom-clean or cinematic-set cleanliness.
